newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Nonferrous Metals HK in JV with Silver Grant.
newsitem.headline: China Nonferrous Metals HK in JV with Silver Grant.

text.p: China Nonferrous Metals Holdings (HK) Co Ltd said on Monday it has formed an equal joint venture with Silver Grant International Industries Ltd.

It said the joint venture, International Copper Industry (China) Investment Ltd, was in turn setting up a joint venture with Jiangxi Copper Company of China to be called Jiangxi Copper Co Ltd, which will seek a listing in Hong Kong.

China Nonferrous, controlled by China National Nonferrous Metals Industry Corp (CNNC), said in a statement that International Copper would have a 28 percent stake in Jiangxi Copper Co Ltd (JCC Ltd) valued at 500 million yuan.
Jiangxi Copper Co, which is also a unit of CNNC, would inject three of its key operations -- Dexing Copper Mine, Yongping Copper Mine and Guixi Smelter, into JCC Ltd, it said.
Jiangxi Copper owns the remaining 72 percent of JCC Ltd.
"JCC Ltd will seek a Hong Kong listing, making it the first China nonferrous metals industrial corporation to be floated overseas," China Nonferrous vice chariman Fang Dacheng said in the statement.
He gave no further details on the listing plan.
